correct_fact: No 14-hospital CIN exists. The analytics vendor is the AHS-GMCB modeling contract (under negotiation April 2026), not a CIN procurement. Same '14-hospital/all 14' CIN framing recurs in other chapters (md lines ~1344, 1420, 1551, 2864, 2979, 5273, 5302) and in the CIN & Shared Services Modeler desc ('across the 14 hospitals') — flag for those chapters' passes.

quote: Act 68 removed the voluntary/optional nature of RBP. The AHS restructuring removes the program silo organizational obstacle.
correct_fact: Before Act 68 RBP was not a voluntary program; it was a GMCB analysis commissioned by Act 113 of 2024 (Dec 2024 report). Act 68 made it a statutory requirement. AHS was NOT restructured: the Act 119 re-envisioning report (Feb 4, 2026) kept AHS unified, favoring better coordination over restructuring.

correct_fact: Act 68 global budgets are conditional ('to the extent resources are available'), exclude Medicaid, and the separate Medicaid hospital global budget was halted July 2026 (GCR 26-089). Not yet mandatory or permanent; make conditional.
